# Deviload 2.7.7

## Linux window controls

This small maintenance update moves Deviload to **Tauri 2.12.5**, with **Tao 0.37.2** and **Wry 0.57.1**. The window runtime includes upstream Wayland decoration fixes for title-bar buttons that could ignore clicks when the initially hidden app window was shown. The matching upstream report also described controls becoming responsive after maximizing the window.

- Keeps the native Linux title bar and the existing window-sizing rules.
- Does not force X11 or change themes, music, downloads, profile storage or updater settings.
- Windows and macOS packages use the same updated runtime; macOS remains an unsigned, unnotarized test build.

Upstream references: [Tauri issue #11856](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/11856), [Tao change #1218](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao/pull/1218).

## Separate WebKit rendering issue

The Debian 13 GNOME/Wayland user reported that this command stopped the interface from freezing:

```bash
WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 deviload
```

That renderer workaround is separate from the title-bar fix. This update does not claim to resolve every graphics-driver or WebKit freeze. The affected user's native GNOME/Wayland confirmation of the updated window runtime is still pending. Rough resizing with the temporary X11 workaround has not been independently confirmed fixed.

The updater identity, signing public key and endpoints stay unchanged. Debian package users can install the new `.deb` over their existing installation. Updater signatures are separate from Windows Authenticode and Apple notarization.
